Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that there were no studio albums between 2000 and 2009 after only seeing the beginning of the Studio albums list (showing entries from the 1960s–1970s). They incorrectly stated the list was complete and stopped further data gathering, failing to scroll through and capture later entries from the 2000s (e.g., Corazón Libre (2005), Cantora 1 (2009), Cantora 2 (2009)), leading to the wrong final answer.
